environment.description: Same Go microservice on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with a size constraint rule that evaluates the request body and all header values. Specifically, a custom rule with priority 1 uses a SizeConstraintStatement on FieldToMatch: Body with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 256, combined (via OrStatement) with a SizeConstraintStatement on FieldToMatch: SingleHeader (Name: x-custom-payload) with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 256. The action is BLOCK. Additionally, the WebACL includes the AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 2 in BLOCK mode, which inspects for anomalous binary patterns in headers and body. The WAF CloudWatch metrics confirm active evaluation with non-zero BlockedRequests count.
